title: List 的 quicklist：大列表按 8KB 节点分段
expected_output:
elements=10000 total_bytes=40000 quicklist_nodes=5
small list nodes: 1
code:
import math
LISTPACK_MAX = 8192  # 8KB 单节点上限

def quicklist(entries):
    total = sum(len(e.encode("utf-8")) for e in entries)
    nodes = max(1, math.ceil(total / LISTPACK_MAX))
    return nodes, total

elems = ["item"] * 10000            # 4B * 10000 = 40000B
n, total = quicklist(elems)
print("elements=%d total_bytes=%d quicklist_nodes=%d" % (len(elems), total, n))
print("small list nodes:", quicklist(["a", "b", "c"])[0])
